#+TITLE: Code Highlighting

A source block is highlighted with Shiki. The default =css-variables=
theme defers every color to a =--shiki-*= custom property, which the O2H
stylesheet binds to the =--o2h-syn-*= tokens — so code re-themes with the
active Style Book instead of a baked palette.

#+BEGIN_SRC javascript
const answer = 42 // the meaning
function greet(name) {
  return `hello, ${name}`
}
#+END_SRC
